errors.text: The proposed yttrium-alloying intervention is neither supported by the cited evidence nor connected to the AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticle system.
The oxygen-vacancy mechanism is imported from Mn-doped ceria, an oxide system, and is not scientifically justified for metallic high-entropy-alloy nanoparticles under vacuum.
The hypothesis does not address the target instability mechanism: active diffusion, Au/Cu surface segregation, melting, and evaporation driven by surface-energy minimization.
No yttrium concentration, exposure duration, atmosphere, particle-size limit, or quantitative stability threshold is specified.
The cited evidence provides no direct evidence that yttrium stabilizes multimetallic nanoparticles at 773–1173 K.
